title: Kongsberg Maritime to supply full automation, DP and propulsion package for two Cadeler WTIVs
summary: Kongsberg Maritime will supply a complete electrical, automation and propulsion package for two new T-class WTIVs being built for Cadeler at COSCO Shipping (Qidong) Offshore, including thrusters, dynamic positioning, integrated automation/vessel control and energy management. Delivery scheduled 2030-2031.

title: Kongsberg Maritime to provide integrated navigation, DP and automation suite for new Solstad/SBM Offshore construction vessel
summary: Kongsberg Maritime will equip a new multi-purpose deepwater installation vessel for Solstad Offshore and SBM Offshore with dynamic positioning, navigation/bridge systems, vessel automation, and a full power/propulsion package. Built in China, delivery H1 2029.

title: ClassNK releases Edition 2.0 of fire-fighting guidelines for container carriers
summary: ClassNK issued Edition 2.0 of its fire-fighting guidelines for container carriers, updating enhanced firefighting provisions beyond SOLAS minimums, including fire hydrants on lashing bridges and revised video-surveillance specs for cargo-area fire monitoring.

title: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries wins South Korea's first overseas icebreaker order
summary: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries secured a contract to build an icebreaker for an overseas customer — the first such order won by a South Korean yard, pushing HHI into specialized ice-class vessel construction.

title: VARD secures its largest order ever — deep-sea research vessel for Inkfish
summary: Vard signed a ~€700m contract with ocean research organization Inkfish to build a 162m next-generation deep-sea research vessel — Norway's highest-value shipbuilding order and Vard's largest single-vessel contract to date.

title: Kongsberg Maritime to design and equip four future-fuel-ready tankers for Transpetro
summary: Kongsberg Maritime signed a ~NOK 300m contract to design and equip four methanol/ethanol-ready handysize tankers for Transpetro, including its K-Bridge/K-Chief integrated automation and navigation (alarm-monitoring) system plus propulsion and tank-gauging systems.

title: OS Energy to equip new offshore wind service vessels with Sonardyne's SPRINT-Nav DP system
summary: OS Energy is fitting Sonardyne's SPRINT-Nav dynamic-positioning reference system (inertial navigation + Doppler velocity log) on a newbuild series of offshore wind service vessels for GNSS-compromised, shallow-water operations. Three confirmed (+3 options), built at Esbjerg Shipyard, Denmark.

title: Fincantieri and Viking sign contracts for two new ocean ships
summary: Fincantieri signed new contracts with Viking for two additional ocean-class cruise ships, extending their newbuild relationship as part of Fincantieri's 2026-2030 business plan.

title: Praxis Automation selected to supply Integrated Platform Management System for Colombian Navy's PES frigate
summary: Praxis Automation secured a contract, via Damen Naval and Alewijnse, to supply its Integrated Platform Management System (IPMS) for Colombia's new PES frigate — centralizing monitoring/control of propulsion, power, auxiliary systems and damage control.

title: Kongsberg Maritime wins equipment contract for new DOF offshore support vessel
summary: Kongsberg Maritime will supply a K-Pos dynamic positioning system, navigation systems, automation/control systems, and a DC hybrid battery-electric power package for a new 110m OSV for DOF, built at CRIST shipyard, Gdynia.

title: Praxis Automation awarded major contract to equip entire Rawabi Vallianz Offshore fleet with DP-2 systems
summary: Praxis Automation was awarded a multi-year contract to equip 59 OSVs operated by Rawabi Vallianz Offshore Services with DP-2 dynamic positioning systems — retrofitting 39 existing vessels and fitting 20 newbuilds — plus customized automation for fleet digitization.

title: Samsung Heavy wins $1.2 billion order for six vessels
summary: Samsung Heavy Industries won a $1.2 billion order covering six new LNG carriers and tankers, continuing a strong run of 2026 newbuild wins.

title: ADNOC L&S exercises options for two more LNG carriers at Jiangnan Shipyard
summary: ADNOC L&S exercised options for two additional 175,000 cbm LNG carriers at Jiangnan Shipyard, bringing its total order there to six vessels (~$444m combined). Delivery 2029; vessels need full cargo containment and handling control systems.

title: Consilium Safety Group acquires Turkish fire & gas detection firm Ares Marine
summary: Consilium Safety Group acquired Ares Marine (Tuzla Bay, Istanbul), serving 70+ shipyards, to expand its capacity to supply/install/maintain fire and gas detection systems across Turkey's shipbuilding industry.

title: Seapeak orders three dual-fuel LNG carriers from Samsung Heavy
summary: Seapeak ordered three 174,000 cbm LNG carriers from Samsung Heavy Industries (~$756m) with X-DF dual-fuel engines, backed by 10-year charters. Delivery H1 2029.

title: OOCL places first LNG dual-fuel container vessel order
summary: OOCL placed its first LNG-fuelled newbuild order, contracting Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding to build 12 vessels with LNG dual-fuel main engines.

title: Knutsen Group adds another LNG carrier at Hanwha Ocean
summary: Knutsen Group placed a $250.3m LNG carrier order with Hanwha Ocean, extending an orderbook of 13 LNG carriers under construction; six chartered to QatarEnergy for 15 years from 2026.

title: Hanwha Ocean wins $980m order for 5 LNG and crude carriers
summary: Hanwha Ocean secured a $980m order for five vessels (LNG carriers and crude carriers), part of a 2025-2026 run that has topped $10bn in new contracts.

title: Baleària takes delivery of third LNG dual-fuel ferry, Mercedes Pinto
summary: Baleària received the Mercedes Pinto, a 123m Ro-Pax ferry built by Astilleros Armon Gijón — third in a series — with dual-fuel engines able to run on bio-LNG or LNG/hydrogen blends.
